scope: Read-only review of original enqueue/locking and isolated frozen proposed patch; bounded tests used fresh temporary stores only.

original_defect_reproduction.fault_boundary: Hard exit after durable plan.json publication and before admission receipt publication.
original_defect_reproduction.original_outcome: A contender under a different queue ID reuses the same attempt/output identity and is admitted. The exact original retry is then rejected as already owned. One contender launch occurs; original plan remains unrecorded.
original_defect_reproduction.assessment: Real ownership gap: unsealed durable plans were invisible to entries() and the collision scan over admitted plans.

patch_review.locking: enqueue() acquires the pre-existing dispatcher flock before scanning partial admissions and holds it through plan/receipt publication. tick() uses the same lock, so a cooperating dispatcher cannot dispatch the contender between ownership inspection and admission.
patch_review.partial_claims: All unsealed peer queue directories are checked. A valid durable partial plan must validate and its queue_id must match the directory name. Attempt ID or output-directory overlap rejects; unrelated identities are permitted.
patch_review.exact_retry: If a plan exists, same queue ID requires the same canonical plan digest. Exact retry continues through normal ownership/fresh-attempt validation and can publish the missing receipt. Once the receipt exists and pins the plan, enqueue is idempotent.
patch_review.scaffold: The caller's own empty scaffold is an allowed repair state; a peer scaffold with no plan is unresolved and blocks unrelated enqueue, rather than allowing unknown ownership to be ignored.
patch_review.admission_receipt: Queue entries with a receipt are governed by existing admission receipt/store/plan pin checks. A crash after receipt publication is handled by idempotent retry; tick can create absent job directories. No scientific qualification is implied.
patch_review.change_scope: Diff adds only partial unsealed-plan scan to experiment_queue.py. execution.py, ledger.py, and run_receipts.py in patch copy match current root files.

patched_queue_tests.method: Loaded existing test_experiment_queue.QueueTests with sys.path forcing patched module first; each test creates its own temporary queue store.
covers: dependency readiness and exact result/release/output pin binding

fresh_store_independent_probes.result: blocks unrelated admission; exact plan repairs scaffold; subsequent unrelated plan succeeds
exact retry returns same receipt pin; tick creates absent job directory, launches exactly once, records completion and releases all capacity
unrelated enqueue fails closed as unsupported queue plan; different plan cannot overwrite durable queue ID plan

gaps.finding: A malformed durable partial plan or unknown non-directory queue entry prevents new enqueue operations. The public API deliberately refuses to overwrite the plan, so operator preservation/quarantine is required.
gaps.recommended_condition: Document a preservation-first, explicit manual repair/quarantine procedure before operational adoption. Do not add automatic deletion/rewrite.

gaps.finding: This remains a local cooperating-process queue over a trusted filesystem; content-addressed pins do not prevent a privileged writer from replacing or rewriting store files outside the API.

not_found: No duplicate attempt/output admission through a valid unsealed partial plan under the dispatcher lock.
No exact retry mutation or double launch after a receipt-published process crash.
No change to dependency readiness or result/release terminal authentication in the narrow patch.
qualification: Infrastructure recovery only; science remains unassessed and promotion/publication is not authorized.
